data.aws_ssm_parameter.ami_id reads the runner configuration parameters at /github-action-runners/<prefix>/<runner>/runners/config/ami_id, which are provisioned by module.runners. Because the lookup names are constructed from configuration rather than module outputs, no dependency orders these reads after module.runners. Add depends_on = [module.runners] to defer the lookups until the parameters exist on an initial deployment.

aws_cloudwatch_event_target.ec2_update_runner_ssm_ami_lambda can attach the Lambda to the enabled scheduled rule before aws_lambda_permission.ec2_update_runner_ssm_ami_lambda grants EventBridge invocation rights. Add a dependency on the permission so the target is activated only after invocation is authorized, avoiding failed invocations during deployment.

aws_cloudwatch_event_target.ec2_update_runner_tags_lambda can begin routing workflow_job events before aws_lambda_permission.ec2_update_runner_tags_lambda authorizes EventBridge to invoke the function. Add a dependency on the permission to avoid an active target with missing invocation rights during deployment.
